title: protea poggei subsp. haemantha
intro: Protea poggei subsp. haemantha, commonly known as Red-flowered protea, is a species of flowering plant in the family Proteaceae. It is traditionally used in South African medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation and infections, due to its health benefits in reducing fever and alleviating pain. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in wound healing and as an antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of Protea poggei subsp. haemantha include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
